lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The announcement came with your name spelled correctly and the scholarship amount bolded. You smiled for a photo and signed on the last line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Then someone asked a question. A signature didn’t match. A paragraph matched too many others. A stamp looked new on an old form.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: When it was over, the letter was thicker. The scholarship was revoked. The file was marked. The people who vouched for you felt the hit too.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You learned that shortcuts don’t erase the distance; they add interest and collect it later, with penalties.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rebuilding is possible. It is just slower than you wish and lonelier than you expect.
